newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Anam Ind sets 15-for-100 bonus.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Anam Ind sets 15-for-100 bonus.

text.p: South Korea's Anam Industries on Monday said it plans to offer a 15-for-100 bonus issue in January 1997 as part of a plan to raise its paid-in capital to 134.4 billion won.

It will issue 3.17 million common and 336,036 preferred shares for distribution to shareholders after the market closes on January 1, a company statement said. The face value of each share will be 5,000 won.
Trading in Anam's shares was halted by the Korea Stock Exchange, as required under South Korean securities regulations for large bonus issues. Trading will resume during Monday's afternoon session.
Anam's shares closed at 15,000 won on Saturday.
